## Motivation

Enable the runtime optimizations accompanying NVIDIA megakernels with one opt-in switch across model paths, instead of carrying a long list of per-optimization environment variables in launch recipes.

## Modifications

- Add `SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_OPTIMIZATION=0` (default). The `SGLANG_ENABLE_` name follows the env-var conventions.
- Reuse `EnvField`'s generic lazy callable-default mechanism: each included `EnvBool` has `SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_OPTIMIZATION.get` as its default. Resolution stays in `environ.py`; call sites and existing capability checks are unchanged.
- **Explicit child values take precedence**, including `0`/`false` with the master on and `1` with the master off. **Unset children follow the master**. The **master defaults off**, preserving current defaults. `.set(None)` retains the existing explicit-None behavior. This switch does not enable the megakernel backend itself.
- Upcoming megakernel follow-up PRs will use this switch instead of adding their own master switch.

Included switches (verified with `git show`, `git log`, and `git blame` against main `4517a5ff1bbd1f944d6bde1819300ed14af7b698`; DSv4.1 source commit `c82f7141ad`, Qwen3.5 source commit `b74fd392e1`):

| --- | --- | --- |

| `SGLANG_DSPARK_DEFER_CONTEXT_KV` | [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450) | Defer draft context-KV commits with existing eligibility checks |
| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_DRAFT_PREP_FORK` | [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450) | Overlap draft metadata preparation with embedding |

| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BLOCKWISE_REJECTION` | [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450) | Use distribution-preserving blockwise rejection sampling |
| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_ONE_LAUNCH_COMMIT_STAGE` | [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450) | Stage the deferred commit in one launch |

| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_MID_FOLD` | [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450) | Write folded draft tokens directly into the sampler buffer |
| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_TARGET_VERIFY_METADATA_GLUE` | [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450) | Capture backend-declared host-free target verify metadata preparation |

| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH` | [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450) | Capture eligible sampled DSpark acceptance and commits |
| `SGLANG_ENABLE_EAGLE_POST_VERIFY_CUDA_GRAPH` | [#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474) | Capture eligible EAGLE post-verify sampling and commits |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_BK_VEC_COPY` | [#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474) | Vectorize small-field copies |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_MKH_N3B` | [#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474) | Reuse unchanged Mamba tracking indices and already staged verify inputs |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_MKH_N3C` | [#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474) | Stage post-verify inputs in one launch (does not enable simulated acceptance) |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_CHAIN_TREE` | [#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474) | Build a chain tree for topk-1 TRT-LLM MHA verify |

| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_SHM_SYNC` | [#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474) | Use same-host shared-memory scheduler synchronization |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_SHM_SYNC_MULTIHOST` | [#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474) | Use hierarchical synchronization for eligible whole-world multi-host groups |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_MULTIHOST_TCP` | [#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474) | Use a TCP leader exchange for eligible two-host groups |

| Switch or group | Source / reason |
| --- | --- |
| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SIM_DRAW_AHEAD` | [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450); `sim_draw_ahead_enabled` only acts when simulated acceptance lengths exist. |
| `SGLANG_SIMULATE_*`, `SGLANG_DSPARK_SIMULATE_FOLD`, fake/forced/test controls | Preserve explicit configuration and benchmark semantics. `SGLANG_ENABLE_DSPARK_SIMULATE_SKIP_SAMPLING` is not registered on this main baseline; this PR does not add it. |
| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL` | [#42808](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42808); selects a model kernel, outside the accompanying runtime switch group. |
| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_BF16_INDEX_LOGITS` | [#45880](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45880); independent kernel precision override with an auto (`None`) default. |
| `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_STAGING` | [#45921](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45921); separate host-table prefill optimization whose tradeoff depends on batch size and ATS support. |
| `SGLANG_ENABLE_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE`, `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_ENGRAM_PEER_SHARDS`, layout and sizing controls | Placement/backend/capacity configuration, outside the runtime group. Peer-shard lookup originates in [#46180](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46180). |
| `SGLANG_ENABLE_METADATA_GLUE_GRAPH` | Predates these follow-ups ([#33561](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33561)); the DSpark-specific metadata switches above remain backend guarded. |

### Mapping to the existing model recipes

- **DSv4.1 / DSpark ([#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450)):** the runtime recipe contains the 16 included DSv4.1 switches plus `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SIM_DRAW_AHEAD`. The latter remains explicit when simulated acceptance is used. The master additionally enables the Qwen3.5 group; most of that group is inactive on this path, but the shared scheduler synchronization and replay input-staging paths below can apply.
- **Qwen3.5 / EAGLE MTP ([#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474)):** the runtime group contains the 11 included Qwen3.5 switches. The master additionally enables the DSv4.1 group; most of that group is inactive on this path, but the shared graph-fill and captured-metadata replay paths below can apply.
- Settings outside these groups remain explicit in the recipes, including `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_METADATA_GLUE_GRAPH` and `SGLANG_EAGER_INPUT_NO_COPY`, where used. Simulation, placement, backend and numeric tuning settings are not replaced by the master.

For the **dedicated DSpark target-verify glue/early path**, the generic `SGLANG_ENABLE_METADATA_GLUE_GRAPH` is not a prerequisite: with the master on and all three child/generic settings unset, both DSv4.1 child switches resolve to true and the eligible runner creates its own metadata glue graph. Explicitly enabling generic metadata glue instead creates `_metadata_glue` first, bypassing `_target_metadata_glue` selection and its early-metadata path. Keep generic-glue recipe settings specific to the path they were measured with.

These four shared switches extend beyond the model-specific recipe in which they were measured:

| Model receiving an additional optimization | Switch | Why it is intended to preserve outputs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DSv4.1 / DSpark | `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_SHM_SYNC` | Single-host TP4 scheduler TP syncs exchange the same values through a shared-memory table. Its multi-host companion switches apply only to eligible group/topology configurations. |
| DSv4.1 / DSpark | `SGLANG_Q35MF_MKH_N3B` | The generic decode/verify replay `_restage_skip` path checks tensor identity, `_version` and stream before skipping duplicate input copies; unchanged Mamba tracking indices are reused only where that state exists. |
| Qwen3.5 / EAGLE MTP | `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH` | Without padding, `reset_padding` is already a no-op; the dense integer copy fast path writes the same fields. |
| Qwen3.5 / EAGLE MTP | `SGLANG_OPT_SKIP_GLUED_REPLAY_VIEW` | Applies when metadata glue is enabled, including the `SGLANG_ENABLE_METADATA_GLUE_GRAPH=1` setting used for #45474's measurements. For an already captured key, `MetadataGlueGraph.run` does not read `fb_view`; calling `replay()` reinstalls and replays the same metadata. |

**GPU A/B on both models (below) measured these paths on the receiving model:** no measurable effect on throughput, prefill latency or accuracy. Explicit child `0` remains available to disable each path.

The remaining model/backend-specific switches are inactive on the other cited recipe: DSpark paths check the DSpark algorithm and their worker/backend/static-graph conditions; EAGLE post-verify and GDN capture have their own worker/backend gates; chain-tree construction applies only to TRT-LLM MHA; the vectorized small-field copy is consumed by EAGLE post-verify graphs; and the Qwen3.5 recipe uses NVFP4 rather than the MXFP4 path. Deferred context-KV retains its cache, disaggregation and attention-DP eligibility checks. EAGLE graphs require CUDA, topk-1 and no attention-DP, with eager fallback for unsupported batches; GDN capture checks the target worker, Triton kernel, layouts and buckets. No additional model-name restrictions are introduced.

### Broader backend applicability

`SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE` affects **any model using deferred-finalize MXFP4 trtllm-gen MoE**, including the `deepseek_v2` / DeepSeek-V3, `deepseek_v4`, `minimax_m3`, `mimo_v2` and `kimi_k3` model paths. It changes the FlashInfer tactic-cache key for 33–96 rows and more than 384 rows by supplying the finalized output shape. This setting was tuned only on DSv4.1; its performance on those other model paths has not been validated here.

## Accuracy Tests

- CPU `test/registered/unit/test_environ.py`: **14 tests passed**, including master off/on/off, all 27 children, explicit `0`/`false`/`1` precedence, unset restoration, explicit `None`, and unchanged defaults throughout the rest of the registry (including simulation controls).
- Compared all **785 existing env defaults** against main: identical with the master off; with it on, exactly the 27 listed switches change to true.
- **GPU (GB300), GSM8K via `sgl-eval`, 200 questions, real acceptance.** A = each model's recipe with its child switches set explicitly; B = the same recipe with those children removed and only `SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_OPTIMIZATION=1`. No errors, empty or garbled outputs in any run.

| Model | Mode | A accuracy | B accuracy | A accept length | B accept length |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3.5-397B-A17B NVFP4 (TP8, MTP) | greedy | 95.0% | 95.0% | 5.446 | 5.446 |
| Qwen3.5-397B-A17B NVFP4 (TP8, MTP) | T 0.6 / top-k 20 / top-p 0.95 | 97.0% | 95.5% | 4.817 | 4.717 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (TP4, DSpark) | T 0 | 98.0% | 98.0% | 3.747 | 3.710 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (TP4, DSpark) | T 1.0 | 95.5% | 97.5% | 3.567 | 3.660 |

Qwen3.5 greedy outputs are identical for all 200 questions. The sampled differences are within the ±1.3-point standard error of a 200-question run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

GB300, `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261028-586355a8`, this PR's code (`3f7fa97971`; later commits only touch the test file) with the NVIDIA megakernel plugin enabled. Both arms use the same source, image, plugin, slots and frozen autotune results; their resolved environments differ only in the child switches versus the master. TPS/User = 1 / per-request ITL.

- **Qwen3.5-397B-A17B NVFP4**, TP8 across two trays, MTP (top-k 1, 7 draft tokens), recipe of #45474 with its 11 switches, plugin `sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega@3bd8c0ba45` (slots `route,mkm,gdn_verify,gdn_pdl,hop,draft_loop,draft_extend`), synthetic acceptance 4.8.
- **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash** (rev `df42c109f1d`), TP4, DSpark, recipe of #45450 with its 16 switches, plugin `sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega@9a21cb037a` with #45450's slots minus `engram`, synthetic acceptance 3.51. Both arms add #46864 so that simulated acceptance keeps the stock accept sampling, as in #45450's measurements. The `engram` slot was dropped from both arms because that plugin commit still read `_HostTable.layout`, which #46893 renamed (fixed since in sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega#29).

**Static decode** (one untimed warm-up sweep per arm. Qwen3.5: about 590 decode rounds × 3 repeats per point, A→B on one node pair and B→A on another, mean of the two pairs. DSv4.1: 30 timed requests at c1 and 40 at c8, A then B on the same node):

| Qwen3.5, c7 | TPS/User P50 / P90 | 904.7 / 865.5 | 910.8 / 868.3 | +0.68% / +0.33% |

- **DSv4.1 / DSpark ([#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450)):** the runtime recipe contains the 16 included DSv4.1 switches plus `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_DSPARK_SIM_DRAW_AHEAD`. The latter remains explicit when simulated acceptance is used. The master additionally enables the Qwen3.5 group; most of that group is inactive on this path, but the shared scheduler synchronization and replay input-staging paths below can apply.
- **Qwen3.5 / EAGLE MTP ([#45474](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45474)):** the runtime group contains the 11 included Qwen3.5 switches. The master additionally enables the DSv4.1 group; most of that group is inactive on this path, but the shared graph-fill and captured-metadata replay paths below can apply.
- Settings outside these groups remain explicit in the recipes, including `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_METADATA_GLUE_GRAPH` and `SGLANG_EAGER_INPUT_NO_COPY`, where used. Simulation, placement, backend and numeric tuning settings are not replaced by the master.

For the **dedicated DSpark target-verify glue/early path**, the generic `SGLANG_ENABLE_METADATA_GLUE_GRAPH` is not a prerequisite: with the master on and all three child/generic settings unset, both DSv4.1 child switches resolve to true and the eligible runner creates its own metadata glue graph. Explicitly enabling generic metadata glue instead creates `_metadata_glue` first, bypassing `_target_metadata_glue` selection and its early-metadata path. Keep generic-glue recipe settings specific to the path they were measured with.

These four shared switches extend beyond the model-specific recipe in which they were measured:

| Model receiving an additional optimization | Switch | Why it is intended to preserve outputs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DSv4.1 / DSpark | `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_SHM_SYNC` | Single-host TP4 scheduler TP syncs exchange the same values through a shared-memory table. Its multi-host companion switches apply only to eligible group/topology configurations. |
| DSv4.1 / DSpark | `SGLANG_Q35MF_MKH_N3B` | The generic decode/verify replay `_restage_skip` path checks tensor identity, `_version` and stream before skipping duplicate input copies; unchanged Mamba tracking indices are reused only where that state exists. |
| Qwen3.5 / EAGLE MTP | `SGLANG_OPT_CUDA_GRAPH_FILL_FAST_PATH` | Without padding, `reset_padding` is already a no-op; the dense integer copy fast path writes the same fields. |
| Qwen3.5 / EAGLE MTP | `SGLANG_OPT_SKIP_GLUED_REPLAY_VIEW` | Applies when metadata glue is enabled, including the `SGLANG_ENABLE_METADATA_GLUE_GRAPH=1` setting used for #45474's measurements. For an already captured key, `MetadataGlueGraph.run` does not read `fb_view`; calling `replay()` reinstalls and replays the same metadata. |

**GPU A/B on both models (below) measured these paths on the receiving model:** no measurable effect on throughput, prefill latency or accuracy. Explicit child `0` remains available to disable each path.

The remaining model/backend-specific switches are inactive on the other cited recipe: DSpark paths check the DSpark algorithm and their worker/backend/static-graph conditions; EAGLE post-verify and GDN capture have their own worker/backend gates; chain-tree construction applies only to TRT-LLM MHA; the vectorized small-field copy is consumed by EAGLE post-verify graphs; and the Qwen3.5 recipe uses NVFP4 rather than the MXFP4 path. Deferred context-KV retains its cache, disaggregation and attention-DP eligibility checks. EAGLE graphs require CUDA, topk-1 and no attention-DP, with eager fallback for unsupported batches; GDN capture checks the target worker, Triton kernel, layouts and buckets. No additional model-name restrictions are introduced.

### Broader backend applicability

`SGLANG_OPT_MXFP4_DEFERRED_FINALIZED_SHAPE` affects **any model using deferred-finalize MXFP4 trtllm-gen MoE**, including the `deepseek_v2` / DeepSeek-V3, `deepseek_v4`, `minimax_m3`, `mimo_v2` and `kimi_k3` model paths. It changes the FlashInfer tactic-cache key for 33–96 rows and more than 384 rows by supplying the finalized output shape. This setting was tuned only on DSv4.1; its performance on those other model paths has not been validated here.

- CPU `test/registered/unit/test_environ.py`: **14 tests passed**, including master off/on/off, all 27 children, explicit `0`/`false`/`1` precedence, unset restoration, explicit `None`, and unchanged defaults throughout the rest of the registry (including simulation controls).

GB300, `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261028-586355a8`, this PR's code (`3f7fa97971`; later commits only touch the test file) with the NVIDIA megakernel plugin enabled.
